files.label: This might be pride, but was so like humility, that it produced all the softening influence of the latter quality on the public mind.

files.path: Week 5/Lesson 3 - The Writer's Desk/Conceding/02 - Moment 2 - Then it is.pdf
files.thumb: thumbs/Week 5/Lesson 3 - The Writer's Desk/Conceding/02 - Moment 2 - Then it is.jpg
files.label: Then, it is true, the propensity of human nature to tell the very worst of itself, when embodied in the person of another, would constrain them to whisper the black scandal of bygone years.

files.thumb: thumbs/Week 5/Lesson 3 - The Writer's Desk/Conceding/03 - Moment 3 - Although the town.jpg
files.label: Although the town scorned Hester, but she nursed its sick.

files.thumb: thumbs/Week 5/Lesson 3 - The Writer's Desk/Conceding/04 - Moment 4 - It is true.jpg
files.label: It is true that the rulers were slow to soften, however many people said the A meant Able.

files.label: While the minister stood on the scaffold at midnight. Mr. Wilson walked past without seeing him.
